> **Note:** this grid shows what the project's `SupportedOn` annotations declare, not what has been verified on a car. No independent public source maps these properties to firmware generations, and a shared annotation (for example SWI68 and SWI165) does not prove the firmwares are equivalent. A ✅ means the code will try the entry; it does not mean the car honours it. Reads and especially writes (windows, door locks, charging, driver assistance) must be confirmed on the vehicle, parked, starting with read-only checks. The car's own Diagnostic screen is the only answer for the car in front of you.
